moments.title: UK Braces for Fifth Heatwave with 36°C Forecast
moments.blurb: A significant heatwave is set to hit large parts of England and Wales this weekend and next week, with temperatures expected to reach up to 36°C, prompting yellow health alerts.

angles.name: Heatwave Warning
angles.copy: Sun's out, thermometers are up! The UK is heading into its fifth heatwave of the year, with temperatures soaring to 36°C next week. Stay safe, stay hydrated! #UKHeatwave

angles.name: Regional Impact
angles.copy: Wales, get ready to feel the heat! Parts of the country are set for a widespread heatwave with temperatures possibly hitting 34°C next week. Are you ready for it?

angles.name: Cooling Down
angles.copy: With 36°C on the cards for next week, what's your go-to for keeping cool? Ice cream, paddling pool, or just hiding indoors? Let us know!

moments.title: The Hundred Cricket Season Nears Finals Day
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament continues with daily matches across the UK, building up to the men's and women's finals at Lord's on Sunday, August 16, 2026.

angles.name: Match Day Buzz
angles.copy: It's another action-packed day in The Hundred! Who are you backing today? The finals are just around the corner on August 16th!

angles.name: London Finals
angles.copy: Lord's is getting ready to host The Hundred finals on August 16th! Will your team be lifting the trophy in London?

angles.name: Cricket in the Heat
angles.copy: Cricket and sunshine! The Hundred continues as the UK heats up. Perfect summer sport, right? Don't forget the suncream!

moments.title: Premier League Pre-Season Fixtures Underway
moments.blurb: Premier League clubs are deep into their pre-season schedules with friendly matches taking place across Europe, preparing for the 2026/27 season kick-off on August 21.

angles.name: Pre-Season Buzz
angles.copy: The Premier League season is almost here! Teams are battling it out in pre-season friendlies now, with the big kick-off on August 21st. Who's looking sharp?

angles.name: Team Predictions
angles.copy: With pre-season in full swing, which Premier League club is showing the most promise for the new campaign? Early predictions are open!

moments.title: Ariana Grande's 'Eternal Sunshine' Tour Lands in London
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande begins her highly anticipated ten-night London residency at The O2 Arena on August 15th as part of her 'Eternal Sunshine' Tour, her only UK dates.

angles.name: Pop Queen Returns
angles.copy: Ariana Grande is bringing her 'Eternal Sunshine' Tour to London's O2 for a massive 10-night residency starting August 15th! Who's got tickets to see the pop queen?

angles.name: London Calling
angles.copy: London is about to get a whole lot more 'Eternal Sunshine'! Ariana Grande starts her epic O2 residency next week. Get ready, Arianators!

moments.title: The Weeknd's 'After Hours Til Dawn' Tour at Wembley
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his record-breaking 'After Hours Til Dawn' stadium tour to Wembley Stadium for five dates, starting August 14th.

angles.name: Stadium Spectacle
angles.copy: The Weeknd is set to light up Wembley Stadium with his 'After Hours Til Dawn' tour for five nights, kicking off on August 14th! Expect huge hits and incredible visuals.

angles.name: Wembley Weekend
angles.copy: Wembley is about to get 'Blinding Lights'! The Weeknd's stadium tour starts next Friday. Who's heading to one of the biggest shows of the summer?

moments.title: Peter Kay Live at AO Arena Manchester
moments.blurb: Comedy legend Peter Kay performs live at the AO Arena in Manchester tonight, August 8th, with all profits going to cancer charities.

angles.name: Local Comedy Hero
angles.copy: Bolton's finest, Peter Kay, is live at the AO Arena Manchester tonight, with all profits supporting cancer charities! Who's ready for a laugh?

angles.name: Good Cause Giggles
angles.copy: Catch Peter Kay in Manchester tonight for some laughs, all for a brilliant cause! A true northern legend.

moments.title: Roots Picnic Makes UK Debut in London
moments.blurb: The iconic Roots Picnic festival makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, on August 8-9, blending music, culture, and community.

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Roots Picnic is here! The legendary festival kicks off its UK debut today at Crystal Palace Bowl. Who's ready for some world-class hip hop, soul and more?

angles.name: London's New Festival
angles.copy: London is hosting the first ever international Roots Picnic today and tomorrow! Get down to Crystal Palace Bowl for a slice of music history.

moments.title: Llŷr Wind Farm Approved in Pembrokeshire
moments.blurb: The Llŷr Wind Farm, a major offshore wind project off the coast of Pembrokeshire, has been approved by the new Welsh Government, expected to create 2,000 jobs.

angles.name: Welsh Green Energy
angles.copy: Big news for Pembrokeshire! The Llŷr Wind Farm has been approved, bringing 2,000 jobs and a huge boost to Wales' green energy ambitions.

angles.name: Jobs for Wales
angles.copy: Fantastic news for Wales' economy and environment! The new Llŷr Wind Farm off Pembrokeshire is set to create thousands of jobs. Powering the future!

moments.title: Rare Evening Solar Eclipse Visible Across UK
moments.blurb: A dramatic deep partial solar eclipse, with over 90% of the sun covered, will be visible across much of the UK on the evening of Wednesday, August 12th, offering an unforgettable sunset spectacle.

angles.name: Stargazing Alert
angles.copy: Look to the skies next Wednesday, August 12th! A rare evening solar eclipse will be visible across the UK, with over 90% of the sun covered. Don't miss this!

angles.name: North Wales View
angles.copy: North Wales is one of the best spots to see next week's dramatic solar eclipse! Up to 94% coverage on Wednesday evening, August 12th. Get your cameras ready!

moments.title: Transport for Wales Rolling Out New Station Technology
moments.blurb: Transport for Wales is introducing new technology, including modernised gatelines and interactive video help points, at seven stations across its network this summer, with Neath (Aug 17-21) and Swansea (Aug 24-28) among them.

angles.name: Travel Tech Upgrade
angles.copy: Get ready for smoother journeys! Transport for Wales is upgrading stations across the network, with new tech coming to Neath (Aug 17-21) and Swansea (Aug 24-28).

angles.name: Smarter Stations
angles.copy: Your Welsh train stations are getting a tech upgrade! Transport for Wales is rolling out new accessibility and support features this summer.

moments.title: Happy 68th Birthday, Madonna!

angles.name: Queen of Pop
angles.copy: The one and only Queen of Pop, Madonna, turns 68 on August 16th! Still influencing generations. What's your all-time favourite Madonna track?

angles.name: Iconic Birthday
angles.copy: Celebrating an icon! Madonna hits 68 next week. From 'Like A Prayer' to 'Vogue', her impact is undeniable.

moments.title: Happy 77th Birthday, Mark Knopfler!

angles.name: Guitar Legend

angles.name: Dire Straits Icon
angles.copy: Money for nothing and the hits for free! Mark Knopfler turns 77 next week. A true rock legend.

angles.copy: Happy 50th Birthday to NSYNC's very own JC Chasez! Celebrating half a century of pop perfection today. Which NSYNC track is still on repeat for you?

angles.name: Pop Nostalgia
angles.copy: It's JC Chasez's 50th birthday! Feeling the 90s/00s nostalgia right now. What an era for pop!

angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to U2's legendary guitarist, The Edge! What an incredible career. What's your favourite U2 anthem?

angles.name: Iconic Sound
angles.copy: That distinctive sound turns 65 today! Celebrating The Edge's birthday. His guitar work is unmistakable.

moments.title: Creamfields 2026 Countdown Begins

angles.name: Festival Excitement
angles.copy: The countdown to Creamfields is ON! Just a few weeks until Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia and more hit Daresbury, Aug 27-30. Who's going?

angles.name: Summer Dance
angles.copy: Get ready for the biggest dance festival of the summer! Creamfields is almost here, bringing the best in electronic music to Cheshire.

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Approaching
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading and Leeds Festivals are set to take place from August 28-30, bringing a huge lineup of rock, indie, and alternative acts to Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park.

angles.name: Festival Season Peak
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds are just around the corner! Who's excited for the massive weekend of music from August 28-30? Which stage will you be at?

angles.name: Rock & Indie Vibes
angles.copy: Get your festival gear ready! Reading & Leeds are set to deliver an epic lineup at the end of August. Summer isn't over yet!
